column1: # The rules apply in order. Only correct forms that are not French words.
# « les mains d'Emory » heard as « les mains des Maury »: the name and its « d' » come back.
# « Emory » at the start of a sentence heard as « A Mira » or « Amira »: only when the name is
# called (a comma follows) or is the whole sentence. Mira and Amira are first names, so nothing is
# touched in the middle of a sentence. Delete these two lines if you know someone called Amira.
